import re

content = old_songs['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Archived Songs" if present
old_songs_list = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by "
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs_list.append((title, frozenset(artists)))
    else:
        # maybe just title? but we'll ignore
        pass

print(old_songs_list)
